title: Proof length of the quadratic circuit reduction
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits. The proof length of the PCPP description assigned to $C$ by the quadratic circuit semantic reduction is at most $2^{12(n+g+2)^2}$, where $g$ is the number of gates of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits
